data.long_meaning: The name Desmond is derived from the Latin word 'desertus', which means 'abandoned' or 'forsaken'. In Christian tradition, it is often interpreted as 'servant of the world'. In the Middle Ages, it was also associated with the Celtic name 'Desma' or 'Desmona', which meant 'godly'.
